scenes.title: Speech for a Judge
scenes.summary: All persuasive speech is addressed to a judge, whether a single person, opponents, or the spectators of a display; and since the characters of the constitutions have been treated, it is clear how to make speeches show character.

scenes.title: The Common Topics
scenes.summary: The particular premises of each kind having been given, the common topics remain: the possible and the impossible, past and future fact, and magnitude, which all speakers use when they amplify or diminish; amplification suits epideictic speech best, past fact judicial, the possible and the future deliberative.
